```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(diamonds, aes(x = carat, y = price, color = cut)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Diamond price by carat", x = "Carat", y = "Price (USD)")
```
